sermon.title: To be in Christ — May 1, 2022
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Anyone in Christ is a new creation. To be in Christ is to abide in the vine and keep His commandments, have zeal for His house as His body, and take in His word. He gives living water and abundant life now.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Message begins at 23:14 after worship.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were uneducated and untrained men, they marveled. And they realized that they had been with Jesus.

faqs.question: What happens to a branch that doesn’t abide?
faqs.answer: It withers and is cast out.

faqs.question: What is one step to being in Christ?
What is another word for flesh?
faqs.answer: The body—we are the body of Christ.

faqs.question: Must we wait to be one with Christ?
Why hide the word in our heart?
faqs.answer: That we might not sin against God.
